question: industrial-roller-doors
unit: $/ea (one complete motorised insulated roller shutter door, 4.0m x 4.5m opening, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)

band.unit: $/ea (one complete motorised insulated roller shutter door, 4.0m x 4.5m opening, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)
band.basis: Sum of six distinct, non-overlapping components (the web line is an uplift on the door unit, not a second door; no QV aggregate or benchmark row is added). Mid-point approx. $11,090/ea. FOUR-DOOR TOTAL for the nominal quantity: $31,360 low / $57,360 high / approx. $44,360 mid, which is the amortisation audit trail for the shared scissor lift and delivery. All rates AKL, GST-exclusive, and exclude preliminaries, margin, design/consent fees, the structural opening, the 3-phase supply/submain/isolator, remote controls beyond the fixed station, loop detectors, painting/making good and any service contract - per the fixed scope. Main cost driver (the insulated aluminium slat curtain) rests on a cited QV proxy row plus a stated 30-50% adjustment evidenced by a fetched NZ price guide; the balance is QV rows or labelled allowances. Allowances total $760-$1,870/door = 10-13% of the band, so the band is not allowance-driven. Band widened and confidence set low because the proxy is a different slat material and the 4.5m height is outside every QV published band, and because QV's own two representations of the 3-phase motor adder differ by about 2x. Not a certified price.

band.unit: $/ea - one complete motorised insulated roller shutter door, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening (4.0m W x 4.5m H, 18 m2), Auckland, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of the eight components above (low $8,622 / high $13,462 per door, rounded). For the nominal quantity of 4 identical doors installed in one visit: TOTAL $34,500 (low) - $53,800 (high), centre about $44,200. Amortised items are the scissor lift (2-3 days hire / 4 doors) and delivery and offload (1 delivery / 4 doors); all other components are per-door. All items are AKL rates (Christchurch/Wellington rates are the same for the QV door rows quoted). Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, the structural opening, the 3-phase supply/submain/isolator, vision panels, wicket doors, fire rating, cyclone upgrade, remote controls/loop detectors/access control, painting to cladding, and any service contract - as instructed. Main cost drivers (curtain assembly and motorisation) are priced from cited QV rows, each with a stated adjustment; the insulated-slats/powdercoat upgrade rests on a fetched NZ price guide. Confidence is LOW because (i) QV rows are unreviewed and their inclusions are not itemised - if the $344/m2 shutter row is supply-only the low end rises by roughly $1,000-$1,800/door; (ii) QV's own per-m2 and per-unit roller-shutter rows imply materially different rates, so the base rate is genuinely uncertain; (iii) the insulation/aluminium adder is a guide figure, not a supplier quote. It is a cost-plan band, not a certified price.

band.unit: $ per ea (one complete motorised insulated roller shutter door, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)
band.basis: Sum of the six priced components per door: QV proxy rate for an interlocking-slat roller shutter (AKL $344/m2 x 18 m2) adjusted x1.20-1.70 to the specified 77mm insulated aluminium powdercoated slat, plus QV 3-phase operator $1,100, plus a shortened-scope electrical connection $250-420, plus an allowance $800-1,600 for the IP54 station, safety edge and photo-eye pair, plus QV scissor-lift hire amortised over 4 doors $70-120, plus a $150-350 delivery/offload allowance amortised over 4 doors. Nominal quantity 4 identical doors, one Auckland site, one install visit: TOTAL $39,200 (low) - $56,500 (high), i.e. $544-$784 per m2 of opening. Amortised items are auditable: scissor lift $280-480 per job, delivery/offload $600-1,400 per job. GST exclusive; excludes preliminaries, margin, design, consent, the structural opening, the 3-phase supply/submain/isolator, and remote controls beyond the fixed station. Not a certified price. Confidence is low because the largest component rests on an unreviewed QV proxy with a judgement-based adjustment for the insulated aluminium slat, which QV does not price.
